$comment: Painting surfaces that do not yet publish the surface contract, as they
stood when the guardrail landed (YaleSites-Internal#1631, Phase 2). See
surface-contract.mjs for what counts as painting and why.
Keys are repo-relative, the same spelling foreground-purity-baseline.json
uses, so the two files can be read side by side.
This is a burn-down list, not an opt-out. Phase 2 converts components in
measured-risk order, so a guardrail that demanded all of them at once
would have been unmergeable; what it does instead is stop a NEW painting
surface-contract.test.mjs enforces both directions: a converted surface
still listed here must have its entry deleted, and an entry whose file no
longer paints a themed background must be deleted too. Adding an entry to
turn a red build green is not a fix -- publish the contract.

components/02-molecules/banner/grand-her.reason: Same shape as the action banner converted in this change -- paints --color-grand-hero-background from the block dial and publishes nothing. Deferred only to keep this change reviewable: the grand hero is the page's largest painted surface and its conversion wants its own visual check across all seven global themes.

components/02-molecules/banner/image/yds.reason: Paints --color-image-banner-background, but the copy sits on a photographic image rather than on that colour for most of its area, so the approved foreground is not simply the theme's text colour. Needs the same treatment as grand-hero and a designer's read on which of the two surfaces the contract should describe.

components/02-molecules/tabs/_yds-tabs.s.reason: Remaps --color-background at a themed scope and paints it at the root. Already the most contract-aware component in the library -- it reads --color-section-foreground for both border roles and --color-section-background for its chrome (#1628) -- so publishing its own would change what those reads resolve to inside a themed tab panel. Wants converting together with the tab chrome rather than ahead of it.

components/02-molecules/quick-links/_yds.reason: Remaps --color-background at a themed scope and paints it at the root. Named alongside tabs in _yds-layout.scss:309-317 as the reason --color-text / --color-background could not be re-pointed from the section side before #1630, so it is entangled with that pair specifically and should convert with tabs.

components/02-molecules/quote-callout/_y.reason: Paints --color-quote-callout-background from the dial and at theme six. Straightforward, but three of its custom properties were inert var() cycles removed in #1629 and the file's per-theme blocks re-declare at identical specificity, so the conversion needs the last-one-wins ordering checked rather than assumed.

components/02-molecules/inline-message/_.reason: Paints --color-inline-message-background from the dial and at theme six. Deferred purely for batch size; no known complication.

components/02-molecules/tile-item/_yds-t.reason: Paints --color-tile-item-theme from the dial and at theme six. Deferred purely for batch size; no known complication.

components/02-molecules/facts-and-figure.reason: The individual fact, paired with the facts-and-figures-group converted in this change. Nested inside that group, so it should be converted once the group's published contract can be measured against it -- converting both in one step would make an unexpected result hard to attribute.

components/02-molecules/taxonomy-display.reason: Paints --color-gray-100 flat on the `default` dial and --color-background on every other, so it needs a foreground for two different surfaces rather than one. The flat-grey half is the same shape as the meta chip lists tracked at #1662.

components/02-molecules/accordion/_yds-a.reason: Paints a flat --color-gray-100 on the accordion ITEM inside a themed accordion, plus white for two global/section-theme combinations. #705 measured the item's 6px accent rule at 42 failures -> 0 and explicitly recorded that the item owns the surface behind it; the fill itself was left. Its functional-element contrast is also still being settled on #1614.

components/02-molecules/meta/profile-met.reason: Paints --color-profile-background across seven per-theme blocks and carries the largest raw-palette foreground count of any meta component (10 in foreground-purity-baseline.json). Wants converting with the rest of the meta family, whose secondary text is being moved onto the contract on the #1662 branch right now.

components/02-molecules/pull-quote/_yds-.reason: Deliberately deferential rather than merely unconverted: it reads --color-section-accent from the enclosing section on purpose (:88-101) so the quote's accent matches the surface it sits on, and the comment there records a load-bearing specificity constraint against its own theme-five override. Publishing a contract here would change what that deference means and needs the decision on #1627 question 5 first.

components/03-organisms/menu/secondary-n.reason: Paints --color-background at a themed scope. Site chrome rather than a Layout Builder block: it is not placeable inside a themed section today, so it cannot exhibit the leak. Listed for completeness of the invariant rather than as pending contrast work.

components/03-organisms/site-in-this-sec.reason: Paints --color-background at a themed scope. Same reasoning as secondary-nav -- site chrome, not section-placeable, so the leak is unreachable. It also declares --color-section-nav-* which is a different namespace and unrelated to this contract.

components/01-atoms/videos/video-backgro.reason: Paints --color-video-background behind a playing video, so the visible backdrop is the video for almost all of the surface's life and the painted colour is a poster/fallback. What the contract should publish here is a genuine question rather than a mechanical conversion.
